driver.alignment: as-of: last FRED observation with date <= gold UTC date; no future fill

regime_primary.name: real_yield_falling_20d
regime_primary.rule: long iff DFII10_asof[t] < DFII10_asof[t-20], else flat

regime_robustness_not_pick.name: below_expanding_40th_of_prior_252
regime_robustness_not_pick.rule: long iff DFII10_asof[t] < 40th percentile of DFII10_asof[t-252:t] (past only)

timing.knowable: regime at day t uses as-of DFII10 through t
timing.enter_exit: next daily open after regime is knowable
timing.hold: while regime on; flatten next open when it flips
timing.catastrophe_sl_note: none on primary; 4.0 daily ATR listed only as unused robustness

costs.slippage_notes: UNMEASURED. results/xau_research_slip.json status=GAP. Book not changed.

baseline.name: always_long_continuous
baseline.rule: one continuous long from first eligible next-open through last bar of the window; same lots/costs (one RT)

score.continue_if: regime_on_days>=30 and PF>=1.0 and net > always_long_net
score.always_long_pf_note: always-long is one RT; binding vs-drift test is net (declared). PF still required >=1 on the regime book.

do_not: short gold as the primary rule
add DTWEX/DXY/VIX to the primary rule
